name: MLCL-equipped single with four private auxiliary context projections
mechanism: Allow each fixed graph/context objective its own trainable projection on one native single hidden representation; test whether assigning the objectives to predictive ensemble routes adds useful predictions beyond a capable single that need not fit all contexts in one auxiliary geometry.
prior_collision: MLCL §§3.1–3.4 is direct private-head/positive-relation allocation ancestry; AMCL already supplies multihead contrastive private MLPs. Graph contexts themselves are saved priors.
operation: For a later frozen complete comparison only: one native SAGE M1 with live pre-output H and its ordinary CE head. Attach four bias-free d×d linear auxiliary maps A_r. Define z_ir=normalize(A_r h_i). The r-th head receives the same predeclared complete (Q_r,E_r) loss as the frozen context study. Total objective = CE + 0.05*(1/4)*sum_r L_(Q_r,E_r)(z_r), temperature0.2. Discard all A_r at serving; use the single ordinary classifier. Fixed X,X-PX,PX,P²X/top16 targets and incidence/ties/order are inherited as data, not retuned. No source code is supplied or active.
routine_fixed_choice: Initialize each A_r to identity so the initial auxiliary objective equals the existing complete mixture objective, with four separately learnable maps thereafter. This is a concrete minimal adaptation choice, not the published MLCL initializer or an additional claimed principle.
essential_references: Capable factorized M1 using this same four-projector auxiliary, if the root admits a later comparison
Genuine independent I4 with every body equipped with all four context projections, if the root admits a later comparison
Frozen private masked candidate and complete matched ordinary anchors; no partial outcome selection
falsifiable_prediction: If one common hidden representation is hurt by reconciling context objectives in a common auxiliary geometry, the four-projector M1 should improve served competence over its identical common-geometry M1. An ensemble-specific context-allocation explanation requires private predictive members to retain useful complete pooled and competence advantages over this equipped M1 and genuinely independent equipped references. If the single/equipped independent references erase that advantage, the claimed allocation benefit is refuted within that task; projection differences alone do not count.
what_failure_means: A negative control result closes only this fixed projection-equipped comparator. It does not diagnose collapse, prove useful graph modes exist, or establish that arbitrary graph targets cannot be learned.
capacity_and_cost: Adds4*d² train-only parameters; zero served parameters/forwards. For T=580 TRAIN and hidden width d, four matrix maps cost about4*T*d² multiply-accumulates and four all-pair similarities about4*T²*d; compared with a mixture M1 reusing one similarity matrix this adds about3*T²*d plus maps. Actual memory/time must be measured if later admitted.
minimal_pair_cost: Ordinary mixture M1 is already available under the frozen roster. A paired source-only control would require3new single fits if later admitted; no hours estimate invented. An eventual superiority comparison must also fund the equipped capable references; this packet admits no fit.
run_authority: Root alone chooses/fixes/qualifies/runs after complete context closure. No current-source edit, fit, scientific server, VALID selection, TEST, rescue grid, novelty or accuracy promise.
supersession_reason: Root requested the continuous within-class teacher-weight limitation; final packet retains that one hypothesis/control instead. This private-projection proposal was never implemented or admitted.
